sections.html: Years of experience are the founder’s, across previous roles. Designit Studio launched in 2026; every case study counted here is published on the Work page.

faq.q: Which industries does Designit specialise in?
faq.a: B2B SaaS, AI products, fintech, EdTech, PropTech and real estate, e-commerce, and automotive HMI.

faq.q: Do you only work with Indian companies?
faq.a: No. We are based in Noida, India, and work with clients in the UAE, the United States and the United Kingdom as well as India, collaborating remotely across time zones.
Yes. Every project starts with domain research: industry conventions, competitor products, regulatory constraints and how users in that sector think.
